attempts.why: Add explicit UA-equivalent hiding for closed details so nested accordion content inside open dropdown is not forced to display:block by dropdown selectors.

selfVerify.reason:
Nested accordion

#accp is display:none with 0x0 box while its

#acc is closed (no open), despite ancestor
.dropdown#dd being open; dropdown
    remains display:flex/visible, so open-dropdown styling not overriding closed-details hiding – suspected bug is gone and no regression.

pick.suspected:
Nested accordion

inside open dropdown stays display:block when its own

is closed because dropdown open/details selectors override the accordion closed-content hiding rule.
